description: After signing in, the service hands back a bearer token whose payload carries a privilege field. The staff-only endpoint reads that field directly, and the verification routine picks its algorithm from whatever the token header declares.

A 64-bit executable prompts for a username and copies it into a 128-byte local array without checking the length. Mitigations report as: stack protector off, non-executable stack on, position-independent code off. A matching libc is shipped in the same directory.
Messages are encrypted with RSA using a small public exponent and a shared modulus across users.
Reverse engineer this crackme -- disassemble it in Ghidra and find the keygen algorithm.
Analyze this pcap in Wireshark to find hidden files in the network capture using file carving.
Use the photo metadata to geolocate the photographer and correlate the username on social media.
Audit this Solidity smart contract on Ethereum. A withdraw function looks like a reentrancy bug and gas is relevant.
Decompile this Android APK. An exported activity stores the session token in shared preferences.
A Flask app renders user input in a Jinja2 template without sanitization. Recover the secret config value.
Search box on a PHP site is vulnerable to UNION-based SQL injection. Dump the users table.
Ciphertext was XORed with a single repeating key byte. Recover the plaintext flag.
Binary prints user input with printf(user) and has a writable GOT. Leak libc and get a shell.
A PNG image hides a flag using LSB steganography. Extract the hidden message.
Crackme XORs its comparison string at runtime. Find the correct password with static analysis.
Layered Base64 then hex encoding wraps the flag. Peel the layers.
Oracle encrypts attacker-controlled prefixes under AES-ECB. Recover the secret suffix byte-by-byte.
Download endpoint joins user-controlled filename into /var/data without normalization.
32-bit binary with gets overflow and a win function that prints the flag.
Message encrypted with Caesar cipher shift. Recover English plaintext flag.
The flag is hidden under base64 and hex encoding layers.
